trigger: An exact technician workstation command fails, hangs, false-passes, contains terminal prompt or transcript contamination, or produces output inconsistent with repository contracts.
preconditions: The operator supplied the shell, available command text, output, and machine boundary.
The repository state can be preserved without reset, clean, overwrite, or force push.
The failure belongs to the technician live-cert, command-handoff, or owned repair surface.

steps.action: Preserve the failed run directory and original operator transcript privately; commit only a minimized synthetic classification.
steps.output: failure boundary, run ID, stage ID, shell, exit identity, evidence path

steps.action: Extract executable input from prompts, duplicated prompts, continuation prompts, stdout, stderr, stack traces, and PowerShell diagnostic metadata. Validate the sanitized candidate with the operator-command envelope contract.
steps.output: prompt-free candidate command plus command-envelope report

steps.action: Identify why existing tests allowed the defect: skipped shell, static token-only check, unexecuted branch, overload ambiguity, path-resolution timing, pager interaction, command-envelope gap, or proof inflation.
Repair the owned harness defect and add the smallest deterministic fixture or validator guard that would have failed before field use.
steps.output: tracked harness files plus validator or fixture

steps.action: Run the operator-command validator, owning validators in Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7, Python contracts, and noninteractive Git hygiene.
steps.output: cross-shell validation ledger and operator-command report

steps.action: Rerun only the sanitized, prompt-free operator command on the affected workstation or a separately authorized equivalent machine.
steps.output: new run evidence at the next honest proof level

steps.action: Commit, push, open/update the PR, report the exact head, and provide an isolated-worktree or tracked-entrypoint command that preserves any local branch.
steps.output: GitHub evidence and executable prompt-free handoff

stopConditions: The failure crosses into unowned product behavior.
The exact operator shell or machine boundary is unknown.
No safe separation between command and transcript can be established.
Repair requires credentials, private evidence, destructive cleanup, merge, deployment, or live mutation without authority.
The candidate cannot be validated in every required shell.
proofCeiling: A sanitized command, repaired harness contract, and cross-shell CI do not prove the original workstation path until the prompt-free operator command passes.
